summary: Independently verified (verification-only, no production repair performed) the predecessor phase's configured-agent-identity threading repair to hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py. Independently reconstructed the production diff (bounded to that one file, one new function _resolve_trusted_executable_for_subject, no def removed), the full production consumer inventory of _current_agent_identity (exactly 3 call sites via AST walk, all correctly classified LIVE_PROCESS_SUBJECT: the frozen ambient _resolve_trusted_executable, its own-environment wrapper consumed only by hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py's git check, and the non-authoritative public diagnostic entry point consumed only by the equally non-authoritative hatp_class_b_conformance.py aggregator -- never by hpac_protected_admin_writer.py or any certification path), and the already-correct hpac_protected_admin_writer.py boundary that threads hpac_pawa_agent_exclusion.resolve_configured_agent_identity()'s protected-record-derived (uid, gids) -- independently confirmed to never itself call os.geteuid() and to fail closed on any live-uid/provisioned-uid mismatch -- into _effective_write_access/_ancestor_chain_safe. Independently reproduced the historical ambient-identity-poisoning defect from the still-frozen, still-present bare _resolve_trusted_executable, and independently proved the repaired ACL helpers resolve deterministically against their real explicit subject even under a poisoned root-like ambient identity, while genuine configured-agent write authority (owner/group/other/ACL) is still detected. Fresh 41-case independent IV suite (38 passed, 3 environment-conditional skips with disclosed skip reasons) written from scratch against primary source, not reusing the predecessor's test bodies. Zero attributable regressions: 37 pre-existing Class-B/topology/environment-lock failures and 2 pre-existing hpac_verifier failures (unrelated to this module) reproduced byte-identical (same node ids) in a disposable detached worktree pinned to the fixed repair-entry SHA. Host generation-1 state inspected read-only (protected root confirmed root-owned, mode 700, uid 501 excluded by ownership/mode alone); no elevated privileges requested; no mutation, no F-5 registration retry, no PPA action, no human/YubiKey ceremony performed. VERDICT: CONFIGURED-AGENT-IDENTITY THREADING REPAIR INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. F-5 CONTINUATION: READY (not begun -- only that a fresh, separately authorized continuation phase may retry the previously blocked PPA registration against the existing generation-1 state). N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED.
